name: MAXLAND
recent: Maxland 于 2026 年 11 月完成供股，共发行 7.557 亿股供股股份及 6340 万张凭单 B，并于 11 月 23 日上市。供股认购率为 47.11%，未达全额认购，但已达到最低认购水平。同期，多名董事及主要股东在供股中认购股份，导致持股变动。
notable: 完成供股，发行 7.557 亿股供股股份及 6340 万张凭单 B，并于 2026 年 11 月 23 日上市。
供股认购率为 47.11%，未获全额认购，但达到最低认购水平。
董事 Chang Keng Sing、Dennis Lim Shie Mien 及 Yin Kong Fung 在供股中认购股份。
risks: 供股未获全额认购，认购率为 47.11%。
供股导致已发行股本大幅增加，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 8 月 31 日）营收为 918 万令吉，环比下降 6.3%，同比下降 8.7%；净利润为 111.6 万令吉，净利润率 12.2%，较上一季度的 -62.3% 转正。

recent_en: Maxland completed its rights issue in November 2026, issuing 755.7 million rights shares and 63.4 million Warrants B, which were listed on 23 November. The rights issue was 47.11% subscribed, below full subscription but meeting the minimum subscription level. Meanwhile, several directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares through the rights issue, resulting in changes in their shareholdings.
notable_en: Completed rights issue, issuing 755.7 million rights shares and 63.4 million Warrants B, listed on 23 November 2026.
The rights issue was 47.11% subscribed, not fully subscribed but meeting the minimum subscription level.
Directors Chang Keng Sing, Dennis Lim Shie Mien and Yin Kong Fung subscribed for shares under the rights issue.
risks_en: The rights issue was not fully subscribed, with a subscription rate of 47.11%.
The rights issue substantially increased the issued share capital, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 31 August), revenue was RM9.18 million, down 6.3% QoQ and 8.7% YoY; net income was RM1.116 million with a net margin of 12.2%, turning positive from -62.3% in the previous quarter.
